_about: Every public-domain Thomas Goodwin (1600-1680, President of Magdalen College, Oxford) text the Word Hoard holds. The target is Nichol's edition, The Works of Thomas Goodwin, D.D. (Nichol's Series of Standard Divines, 12 vols, 1861-1866), Internet Archive OCR text, raw and unconverted (the Edwards precedent); one complete scan series, each volume number read off its title-page OCR. CCEL has no Thomas Goodwin (its 'goodwin' is William Watson Goodwin's Greek Grammar) and Gutenberg has none (its 'Moses and Aaron' is by a different Thomas Goodwin, d. 1642). Modern reprints are excluded.
